# The reproduction llvm-beanz linked from the issue thread
# (https://godbolt.org/z/39Khq117f) compiles the single-line source with:
#
#     -T lib_6_6
#
# cmd.txt lowers this to `-T ps_6_0 -E main` for one reason: the diagnostic is
# identical under both profiles (verified -- see variant-lib66-main-debug.txt,
# same message at the same source column), and ps_6_0 exists in every release
# back to the v1.4.1907 bisection floor while lib_6_6 requires v1.6.2106 or
# later. Using lib_6_6 would silently discard roughly a third of the release
# history as `invalid-probe`, on a profile that is incidental to the bug.
#
# The reporter's own configuration is unknown -- the issue quotes line 175 of a
# private `hlsl.hlsl` described as a ray-tracing shader, which is consistent
# with a lib_6_x profile but is not stated. Nothing else was changed: no
# workaround flags were inherited, and the source line is copied verbatim from
# the linked session.
-T lib_6_6 repro.hlsl
